module: Small UI router utilities: detection and resolution of relative route names (Angular "^." and Vue "./", "../" styles), deep table merging and resolution of a "module.func" function reference into a callable Lua function. Used by the router and its services.
notes: The code itself flags (TODO) that the relative resolution functions should be cleaned up or removed; routeManager.resolveRouteName is the newer version.
resolveFunctionReference loads the extension on the fly: `extensions[moduleName]` triggers automatic loading.

isRelativeRoute.desc: Returns whether the route name is relative: starts with '^' (Angular) or '.' (Vue).

returns.desc: true if relative; false for a non-string.

resolveRelativeRoute.desc: Converts a relative route into a dotted absolute name relative to the current state. "^^.x" or "../../x" go up n levels; "./x" stays at the same level (adds a child); '/' become '.'. An absolute route is returned as is.

currentState.desc: Dotted name of the current route.

deepMerge.desc: Recursively merges `source` into `target` (modified in place): common tables are merged, other values are overwritten by those from source. If source is not a table, returns source (or target if source is nil).

resolveFunctionReference.desc: Resolves a "module.func" string (split at the last dot) into a function of the matching extension.

contextLabel.desc: Label used in error messages (default "Function reference").
